_comment: ONE corpus, read by two independent executors, so a disagreement is a
test failure rather than a discovery:
pre-commit guard end to end in a scratch git repository.
daemon_expected is a PIN, not a second parser: it records what the real
loader returns today, so a PyYAML or pydantic upgrade that changes YAML
boolean semantics turns this RED and a human decides.
legacy_regex_saw records what the REPLACED pattern
(check-judge-flag.ps1:114, before 2026-08-30) would have matched. It is
kept so the reason the pattern was removed stays executable rather than
becoming a claim in a document.
Cases are generated by MECHANISM - scalar case, scalar quoting, key
quoting and escaping, node style, tag, alias, merge key, document
structure, whitespace, comment, relocation - not collected from what a
